info.title: SDAI MNN model catalog
info.description: Static catalog metadata for complete MNN model bundles. Bundle integrity is validated separately against manifest schema version1.

get.description: Returns only published complete compatible MNN bundles. An empty list means that no bundles are currently distributed. HTTP or decoding errors remain failures.

200.description: Complete current model catalog, possibly empty.

default.description: Static host or transport error. The client does not decode an error response as a catalog.

schema.description: Error document from the static hosting provider; retained as an HTTP failure.

MnnCatalog.description: Available complete model archive entries; empty before initial distribution.

MnnCatalogEntry.description: One downloadable MNN SD 1.5 bundle supported by the Android provider.

id.description: Stable catalog identity and app-private directory name; never a filesystem path.

sources.description: Verified immutable HTTPS URLs returning the complete root-layout ZIP bundle.
